description:
Returns the invoice custom fields of this company, each one with the options that apply
to the query, ordered by `key`. A field with `suggest_values: false` carries no options.

- **Options per customer:** with `customer_id`, each field carries the common options and
  those of that customer, which is what an invoice for that customer can offer. Without
  it, only the common options. To page through every option of a field, use
  `GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options`.
- **Archived:** archived fields and options are left out unless `include_archived=true`.

**Closed catalogue.** A company defines a small set of fields: this collection carries no
`pagination`, takes no `page`/`limit`, and every response holds the whole set.

BeeL API endpoint: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

customer_id.description: Adds the options of this customer to the common ones. A value that names no customer of this company is not an error: only the common options come back.

include_archived.description: Include archived fields and archived options.

name: beel_list_custom_fields
